headline: Setting the FY27 tax rate, with a $3,000,000.00 free cash transfer and a tax levy stabilization transfer.
summary: Mayor Sarno filed the first two items, both about moving money into the FY27 budget. The third item sets the FY27 tax factor.
items: Stabilization transfer for tax levy from Treasury bills interest (Mayor Sarno)
Transfer of FY26 certified free cash to FY27 estimated revenues, $3,000,000.00 (Mayor Sarno)
